Acrobatics.uniqueEffect: Add 1 to the Attack Strength of this Move if the user does not have an Attach Card attached to it.

Behemoth Blade.uniqueEffect: Add 1 to this Move's Attack Strength if the opponent is Dynamaxed / Gigantamaxed.

Disable.uniqueEffect:
Select one of the opponent Pokémon's Moves. They cannot use that Move for the rest of the Battle. If the opponent's Pokémon only has 1 available Move, this Move has no effect.

NOTE: This effect ignores the normal timing for when effects apply. This effect applies before the opponent selects a Move for the Battle Round. If the Defender uses this Move and chooses the Attacker's selected Move for this round, the Attacker must select a different Move.

Encore.uniqueEffect: For the rest of the Battle, the opponent's Pokémon can only select the Move they selected during this Battle Round.

Facade.uniqueEffect: Add 1 to this Move's Attack Strength if the user has a Status Condition.

Fake Out.uniqueEffect: The opponent's Pokémon gains Disadvantage for this round if this Move is used on the user’s first round in Battle.

False Swipe.uniqueEffect: If you defeated a wild Pokémon using this Move, add 1 to your Catch Roll to when you attempt to catch that Pokémon.

Fell Stinger.uniqueEffect: If the user wins this Battle Round, they gain Double Advantage in the next round of this Battle.

Fire Fang.uniqueEffect: Roll the Effect Die again. If the result is odd, the opponent's Pokémon gains the Burned Status Condition. If the result is even, the opponent's Pokémon gains Disadvantage for this Battle Round.

Roll the Effect Die:

1-2: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Poisoned Status Condition.

5-6: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Sleep Status Condition.

G-Max Rapid Flow.uniqueEffect: Ignore the effects of Protection on your opponent's Moves for this round.

G-Max Replenish.uniqueEffect: The user chooses an Attach Card from the Item card discard pile and puts it into their hand. This effect can only be used once per Battle.

G-Max Stun Shock.uniqueEffect:
Roll the Effect Die:

1-3: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Poisoned Status Condition.
4-6: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Paralyzed Status Condition.

Haze.uniqueEffect: Any Move effects that are used by the opponent's Pokémon that affect itself are ignored.

Hydro Steam.uniqueEffect: If the Harsh Sunlight Field Move card is in play, the user receives a +1 bonus to their Attack Total instead of the -1 penalty.

Max Guard.uniqueEffect:

Nature Power.uniqueEffect:
Roll the Nature Power Die. This Move becomes that Move for this Battle Round.

NOTE: The Nature Power Die is a custom die on the TTS version of this game. In PnP, you can roll a d8 instead and consult this table.

No Retreat.uniqueEffect: The user cannot be switched out for the rest of the Battle.

Octolock.uniqueEffect: The opponent's Pokémon has Disadvantage for the rest of the Battle.

Odor Sleuth.uniqueEffect: The user ignores both Disadvantage caused by Ghost Type Pokémon and Type Effectiveness against Ghost Type Pokémon for the rest of the Battle.

Perish Song.uniqueEffect: The user gains the Cursed Status Condition.

Plasma Fists.uniqueEffect: All Normal Type Moves become Electric Type during this Battle.

3: The opponent's Pokémon gains the Confused Status Condition.
